QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_42

question.text: When all capital calls are met, MOIC equals which other multiple?

explanation.text: The Logic: When all calls met, Total Invested Capital = Total Paid-in Capital, so MOIC = TVPI. The Trap: DPI/RVPI are subsets; PIC Multiple doesn't capture returns. Cross-Exam Context: From Section 6.2.1.2. Distributor's Pro-Tip: If MOIC ≠ TVPI, calls may still be outstanding — flag to investor.
